[[File:Caemlyn Road.jpg|thumb|right|The Caemlyn Road.]]
The '''Caemlyn Road''' is one of the major highways of the [[Westlands]]. It runs for well over a thousand miles from [[Baerlon]] to [[Aringill]], with the city of [[Caemlyn]] being the largest settlement along its route. The road crosses the [[Manetherendrelle|River Manetherendrelle]] at the [[White Bridge]], an enormous [[One Power|Power]]-wrought structure. Settlements along the road include [[Whitebridge]], [[Arien]], [[Breen's Spring]], [[Four Kings]], [[Market Sheran]] and [[Carysford]].
